objective: Create one clear three-quarter establishing reference of an empty compact artist's studio, with an unmistakable off-center inside corner and two adjacent walls receding in opposite directions.

canvas_and_camera.composition_rule: One image on one canvas, no collage or separate angles.
canvas_and_camera.camera_position: Eye-level camera close to the front-right side of a square room, aimed diagonally at the opposite inside corner. The vertical seam where the two far walls meet must land at about 35% of the image width, distinctly left of center.
canvas_and_camera.view: Strong two-point diagonal perspective, not a view square-on to any wall: the left wall stretches from the left foreground back to the off-center corner, while the adjoining right wall runs from that corner toward the right foreground. Both wall-floor seams visibly angle toward the corner. Show a generous unobstructed floor foreground and enough ceiling to read room volume.
canvas_and_camera.optics: Rectilinear 28 mm lens, level camera, upright verticals, natural proportions, deep focus.

environment.type_and_style: Quiet contemporary artist's studio in a renovated loft, functional and uncluttered, warm white, pale oak, and muted blue-grey palette.
environment.scale_and_shell: Approximately square five-meter room, warm-white plaster walls meeting at a visible 90-degree inside corner, pale oak plank floor, white ceiling with simple exposed beams.
environment.openings: One tall daylight window halfway along the left wall; one closed blue-grey door at the far end of the right wall near the image's right edge. The window and door are on different adjoining walls.

spatial_design.staging_anchor: A single broad wooden workbench set against the right wall just beyond the off-center corner.
spatial_design.zones: Empty pale oak floorboards occupy the front third. The corner and workbench occupy the middle ground. The left-wall window and right-wall door remain plainly visible in the background.
spatial_design.circulation: A wide clear floor path crosses from the front foreground to the door at the right. No furnishing blocks the window or door.
landmark_relationships: The workbench sits on the right wall, immediately to the right of the visible off-center inside corner.
The window is on the adjoining left wall, to the left of the corner.
The door is farther right along the workbench wall and remains visible beyond it.

set_dressing: A single ceramic vase and a short stack of blank canvases on the workbench, one plain wooden stool in front of it; restrained objects that do not obscure the corner or paths.
materials_and_condition: Clean warm-white plaster, lightly worn pale oak planks, natural unfinished wood workbench, matte blue-grey painted door; realistic texture and construction.

lighting_and_atmosphere.primary_source_and_direction: Soft daylight enters only through the left-wall window, travelling toward the right wall.
lighting_and_atmosphere.shadow_direction: Soft consistent shadows fall toward the right side of the room.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Clear neutral daylight with no fog or heavy grade; architecture remains readable.

rendering_and_consistency_locks: Photorealistic unoccupied room, realistic scale, crisp spatial detail.
The inside corner is visibly 35% from the left edge, never centered; the two adjoining walls and their floor seams visibly recede in different directions.
Keep the left-wall window, right-wall workbench and door, broad foreground floor, and left-to-right daylight consistent.
negative_prompt: front-on view of a single wall, one-point centered room composition, centered far wall
corner centered in the image, corner hidden by furniture, flat wallpaper appearance
fisheye, dollhouse cutaway, top-down view, warped verticals, blocked door
duplicate windows, duplicate workbenches, floating objects, people, logos, readable text
final_generation_instruction: Generate ONE photorealistic 16:9 landscape image of an empty artist's studio from a true diagonal three-quarter camera. Make the vertical inside corner appear at 35% of the canvas width, with one long left wall and one adjoining right wall visibly angled away from it in different directions. Show large clear oak floor foreground, left-wall window, right-wall workbench and door, natural rectilinear geometry, and soft daylight from the left. Do not make a centered frontal room view.
